note: SYC's LANK and FK r's DELKOD are documented nowhere in their registers, so each entry mints its own variable on the named variant, held once over its holdings_period; LANK's authored data_warning annotates its holding. KOD is documented on SYC_A from 2015, so its entry is refused as stale, and KOD keeps its documented 2015-2023 state under its own slug, even though its 2005-2014 holding does not overlap those years: the minted name would be the documented variable's own source id, and a documented column is carried instead. The SOS zone is curating and syc.auto.toml pins LANK as auto-lank; the authored lank entry takes precedence, as naming conversion gives it.
fails_if: `_compile_provider_columns` matches the variant by another spelling than the register's errata label (DELKOD or LANK is stale), drops the pooled holdings period or the authored data_warning, admits a mint of a column the register documents (KOD gains a second variable), or lets a refused mint's claim drop the documented column's native naming (KOD loses its 2015-2023 state: unresolved_catalog_identity), or picks a mint's slug other than by naming conversion's precedence (LANK publishes as the generated auto-lank instead of the authored lank)
